title: Deep Learning Analysis of Echocardiographic Images to Predict Positive Genotype in Patients With Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
summary: Original publisher full text was reviewed through Methods and Results. The study reports a concrete AI-enabled scientific/clinical finding with identifiable cohort or dataset, comparison and quantitative result; this is eligible as an AI-enabled discovery/diagnostic result, with the stated validation limitations.
ai_technology: DCNN analyzes echocardiographic images and adds probability to established clinical scores; Grad-CAM localizes image features.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: 99 HCM patients (45 positive genotype, 54 negative); DCNN probability AUC 0.76 and combined Mayo+DCNN AUC 0.86 versus Mayo 0.72; Toronto+DCNN AUC 0.84 versus 0.75.
evidence.unknown: Methods define genotype-labeled cohort and bootstrap AUC comparison; Results report sensitivity/specificity/PPV/NPV and sensitivity analysis, without external cohort.
evidence.ai_role: DCNN analyzes echocardiographic images and adds probability to established clinical scores; Grad-CAM localizes image features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
